items.description:
Bootlegger Coffee Company is a specialty coffee chain that sources and prepares its beans consistently and sustainably, building each store as a space for the community around it to gather. The Brackenfell Corner branch keeps to the group's all-day format, serving breakfast, brunch and lunch alongside its coffee menu, with a kids' menu, free wifi and takeaway all on offer for dine-in or on-the-go customers.

The store trades from Brackenfell Corner, a neighbourhood shopping centre on the corner of Frans Conradie Drive and Paradys Street in Brackenfell, sharing the centre with supermarkets, clothing stores and other everyday retailers. It is a convenient stop for shoppers and nearby office workers wanting a sit-down breakfast, a mid-morning coffee or a casual lunch without leaving the centre.

Bootlegger XS Salt River is a branch of the Bootlegger Coffee Company group, a specialty coffee chain that prepares its beans consistently and sustainably. The Salt River store serves all-day breakfast, lunch and brunch, with a kids' menu, free wifi and takeaway options, and trades on a halaal basis.

The store is on Brickfield Road in Salt River, close to sister branches in Woodstock and Observatory that fall under the same group. It works well for commuters wanting a coffee on the way to work, families after a relaxed weekend brunch, and anyone nearby looking for a dependable, freshly brewed cup.

BP Wavecrest Motors is a fuel station operating under the BP brand, offering forecourt fuel service with attendants on hand to fill up petrol and diesel around the clock. As a BP-branded site, it forms part of the BP Rewards loyalty programme, which lets customers earn cashback on fuel and other purchases by presenting a BP Rewards card, physical or virtual, at the pumps.

The station is on the corner of Dennegeur Avenue and Agulhas Street in Strandfontein Village, Cape Town, serving the surrounding residential area. Open 24 hours, it suits early commuters, late-night travellers and anyone needing fuel, basic forecourt services or a quick convenience stop outside normal trading hours.

Brick Lane Eatery is a casual restaurant tucked along the canals of Century City, known locally as a hidden gem for good value food and friendly service. The kitchen turns out burgers, pub-style dishes and vegan options, served in an open-plan space with both downstairs and upstairs seating, an indoor fireplace for colder days, and a selection of board games for guests who want to linger.

The restaurant is dog-friendly, with outdoor seating under the trees that is popular with families, and the upstairs area is set up for private functions such as birthdays, kitchen teas and corporate events. Found at The Quays on Park Lane in Century City, it suits a relaxed lunch, a family outing or a small private celebration.

BUCO Montague Gardens is a branch of the BUCO hardware and building-materials chain, stocking timber, cement, electrical supplies and general DIY and home-improvement products alongside its building-materials range. The store serves both trade customers sourcing bulk supplies and home DIY shoppers, with staff on hand to help with cutting timber and boards to size.

The branch trades from Marconi Road in Montague Gardens, within reach of other BUCO stores across the northern and southern suburbs. It is a practical stop for builders, contractors and homeowners tackling renovation or maintenance projects who need hardware, building supplies or advice on a project.

Builders Warehouse is a large-format hardware and home-improvement chain under the Massbuild group, built around a broad DIY and garden range that spans building materials, tools, paint, plumbing, electrical supplies, and indoor and outdoor living products. Stores typically combine a bulk trade counter for contractors with aisles aimed at home DIY shoppers, plus seasonal promotions and catalogues running throughout the year.

The Constantiaberg branch trades from the corner of Main Road and Bark Street in Retreat, serving the southern suburbs with its full range of building supplies and home-improvement products. It suits contractors restocking a site, as well as homeowners planning a renovation, repair or garden project who want a wide range of stock to choose from in one visit.

C4 EcoSolutions is a climate change consultancy that designs and implements carbon, conservation and community-focused projects, working on ventures across Africa, Asia and beyond since 2006. Its work spans carbon project development for investors and developers, climate adaptation projects, and published case studies and research that document the outcomes of its interventions.

The consultancy's team regularly represents its work at international forums such as COP31, contributing to sessions on carbon accounting, climate finance and the energy transition. From its base in Dennendal, Cape Town, it works with investors, project developers and community partners who want credible, well-documented climate projects rather than quick carbon offsets.

Cabstrut supplies cable management and support systems for power, data and industrial reticulation projects, with a range that includes cable ladders, trays, strut channelling, trunking and related accessories. The company holds ISO 9001 certification and DNV quality assurance, and positions its product range as suited to the needs of businesses and industries across South Africa.

Operating through a nationwide network of branches, Cabstrut's Ndabeni site serves contractors, electrical installers and industrial clients in and around Cape Town who need cable support systems for new builds or upgrades. The branch forms part of a broader South African operation offering technical catalogues and pricing support alongside its physical stock.

Cafe Pescado is a casual, laid-back restaurant on St Georges Street in the heart of Simon's Town, serving a wide-ranging menu of pizzas, pastas, burgers and seafood. Its seafood specialities include prawns and calamari, prepared alongside the usual casual-dining favourites for diners after a relaxed meal in a seaside setting.

The restaurant regularly hosts live music, giving it a lively atmosphere alongside its food offering, and draws both locals and visitors exploring Simon's Town's harbour area. It suits a casual dinner out, a bite before or after a walk along the waterfront, or a sociable evening with music as part of the experience.

Calamari Fisheries is a fast-food seafood outlet at Richmond Corner in Richwood, part of a Cape Town-based chain built around fried and grilled fish and chips. Calamari is a signature order, served by weight alongside other classic seafood takeaway options such as hake, chips and other fried sides for customers wanting a quick, affordable meal.

The branch trades from the Richmond Corner centre on the corner of Plattekloof and Tygerberg Valley Roads, serving the Richwood and wider Milnerton area alongside the centre's other shops. It is a straightforward stop for a fish-and-chips takeaway, whether for a family dinner, a quick lunch, or a casual meal collected on the way home from work.

Caltex Lansdowne Corner is a fuel station operating under the Caltex brand, paired with a FreshStop convenience store on the same forecourt. FreshStop outlets are designed as a quick stop alongside the fuel pumps, typically offering snacks, drinks, tyre and wheel services and other everyday convenience items for motorists filling up.

The station trades from the Lansdowne Corner Shopping Centre at the corner of Jan Smuts Drive and Govan Mbeki Road in Lansdowne, operating around the clock. It is a convenient stop for shoppers visiting the centre, commuters passing through Lansdowne, and anyone needing fuel or a quick snack outside regular shopping hours.

CampusKey Rosebank is a private student accommodation property near the University of Cape Town, offering fully furnished private rooms across a range of tiers from standard single rooms to platinum and balcony options. Residents have access to uncapped wifi, shared study and social spaces, an on-site cafe, and around-the-clock security.

The property is on Main Road at the corner of Rose Street in Rosebank, within walking distance of UCT's upper and lower campuses. It is aimed at students wanting a secure, all-inclusive base close to lectures, with short-stay options also available for visitors passing through Cape Town for shorter periods.

Cape Care Pharmacy is a community pharmacy in Parklands offering a dispensary alongside everyday health services such as wellness checks, injections and flu vaccinations. It also stocks baby care and wound care ranges, serving as a local option for prescriptions and over-the-counter health needs.

The pharmacy delivers to customers within a 5km radius for orders over a set value, making it a practical choice for residents who would rather not travel for routine medication or health products. Based on Parklands Main Road in the Village on Main centre, it serves the Parklands community with long trading hours through the week.

Cape Paradise Lodge and Apartments is a guest house and self-catering apartment property in Higgovale, on the slopes of Table Mountain. It offers a bed-and-breakfast lodge with guest rooms built around a garden pool, alongside self-catering apartments for guests who prefer to cater for themselves during their stay.

Set above Kloof Street, the property is within walking distance of restaurants, cafes and a supermarket, and close to attractions such as Table Mountain, Robben Island tours and Camps Bay. Free parking and a shared lounge are available, making it a comfortable base for both first-time visitors and regular travellers to Cape Town.

Cape to Cuba is a Cuban-inspired restaurant and cocktail bar in Kalk Bay, built around Cape-Cuban fusion cuisine, seafood and mojitos, and a local fixture in the harbour area since 1999. Hemingway's Bar operates alongside the restaurant as a bohemian cocktail spot, merging food and drinks into one Havana-styled space decorated around a literary, old-world theme.

The venue is known for its lively atmosphere and regular live music, drawing both locals and visitors to Main Road in Kalk Bay for an evening by the harbour. It suits a long seafood dinner, cocktails with a view of the water, or a night out built around the restaurant's Cuban-inspired menu, cocktail list and entertainment.

Carlton Hair - Blue Route is a hair salon offering a full range of services including cuts, colouring, balayage, highlights, blow-dries, keratin treatments, permanent straightening and children's haircuts. It operates as part of the Carlton Hair chain, a South African hairdressing group that has built a name through precision cutting and colour work.

The salon trades from Blue Route Mall on Tokai Road in Tokai, among a cluster of beauty and hair businesses in the centre. It suits clients wanting a reliable, chain-backed salon for everything from a simple trim to more involved colour and styling treatments, with long trading hours through the week and over weekends.

Cash Crusaders Brackenfell Corner is a branch of the national buy-sell-trade chain, dealing in second-hand electronics, tools, cameras, musical instruments and other everyday goods. Customers can sell unwanted items for cash, use a valuable as security for a short-term loan, or shop the pre-owned stock for a lower price than new, whether they are after a laptop, a power tool or a watch.

The store trades from Brackenfell Corner Shopping Centre at the corner of Frans Conradie Drive and Paradys Street, alongside the centre's other retailers including supermarkets and clothing stores. It runs separate retail and buyshop trading hours, so customers selling or pawning goods should check which hours apply before visiting.

Cash Crusaders Eerste River is a branch of the second-hand goods and pawnbroking chain, buying, selling and trading pre-owned phones, computers, gaming consoles, power tools, appliances and home entertainment equipment. Customers can also use a valuable item as security for a 30-day loan, or sell unwanted goods for cash on the spot.

The store is in 1ste Rivier Mall at the corner of Plein and Pella Streets in Eerste River, with separate hours for its retail shop floor and its buyshop counter where items are brought in to sell or pawn. It is a practical option for residents looking for affordable pre-owned electronics and appliances, or a quick way to raise cash against something they own.

Cash Crusaders Kuilsriver is a branch of the national second-hand goods retailer, trading in new and pre-owned cell phones, cameras, computers, laptops, consumer electronics, jewellery, watches, musical instruments and sporting equipment. The retail concept lets shoppers buy quality used items at a reduced price while also giving sellers a way to turn unwanted goods into cash.

The branch operates from River Park Shopping Centre on Nooiensfontein Road in Kuils River, serving the surrounding community. It is a useful stop for anyone hunting for a bargain on electronics or tools, or wanting to sell, trade or pawn an item they no longer need.

Cash Crusaders Tokai is a branch of the second-hand goods and pawnbroking chain, stocking pre-owned cellphones, computers, gaming consoles, power tools, car audio equipment, musical instruments and home appliances. Shoppers can buy quality used goods at lower prices than new, while sellers can trade in or sell items for cash.

The store trades from Kirstenhof Shopping Centre at the corner of Main and Tokai Roads in Kirstenhof, within the same centre as a Pick n Pay. It suits residents looking for an affordable alternative to new electronics and appliances, or anyone wanting to turn spare gadgets and tools into quick cash.

Cashbuild is a South African hardware and building-materials retailer founded in 1978, built around a model of stocking cement, timber, roofing, plumbing and general hardware supplies for builders and DIY customers across the country. The chain has grown into one of the country's established building-materials retailers, with branches reaching into townships and smaller towns as well as larger centres.

This branch trades from the Philippi Shopping Centre on Lansdowne Road in Philippi, serving the surrounding community with building supplies for construction, renovation and repair projects. It is a practical stop for contractors restocking materials and homeowners tackling smaller DIY jobs alike.

C'est La Vie is a French-style artisan bakery and coffee shop on Recreation Road in Fish Hoek, known for pastries and croissants baked on site alongside its coffee menu. The bakery leans into a classic patisserie style, giving it a different character from the area's more casual cafes, with baked goods meant to be eaten fresh rather than mass-produced ahead of time.

Open mornings only, the bakery draws early risers after a fresh croissant or pastry with their coffee before the rest of the day gets going. It suits a quiet breakfast stop, a coffee and pastry on the way to somewhere else, or picking up a few baked goods to take home for later in the day.

Checkers Langverwacht Plein is a branch of the Checkers supermarket chain, stocking groceries, fresh produce, meat, bakery and household goods for everyday shopping. As part of the wider Checkers network, the store also supports the Sixty60 on-demand delivery service, letting customers order online for delivery from a nearby branch within about an hour, alongside the chain's usual in-store Xtra Savings deals.

The supermarket trades from Langverwacht Plein shopping centre at the corner of Langverwacht Road and Kloof Avenue in Kuils River, serving the surrounding residential area. It is a convenient grocery stop for the local community, whether for a full weekly shop, a quick top-up visit, or picking up a last-minute dinner ingredient.

Checkers Westgate Mall is an anchor supermarket inside Westgate Mall in Mitchells Plain, stocking groceries, fresh produce, meat, bakery and household essentials for the surrounding community. The store includes an in-store MediRite pharmacy, giving shoppers access to a dispensary and basic health products during the same visit, alongside the usual supermarket departments.

Running regular catalogue promotions throughout the year on groceries and household items, the store serves as one of the mall's main draws for everyday shopping. It is a practical stop for Mitchells Plain residents doing a full grocery run, picking up a prescription, or stopping in for a few essentials between other errands.

Clicks is a South African health, beauty and pharmacy retail chain built around ClubCard rewards, an in-store Health Hub and Beauty Hub, and a full dispensary at most branches. The Blue Downs store carries the chain's usual range of medicines, toiletries, cosmetics and household health products alongside its pharmacy counter, with staff able to advise on common over-the-counter remedies.

This branch trades from Blue Downs Shopping Centre at the corner of Hindle Road and Eersrivier Way in Blue Downs, serving the surrounding community with extended weekday and weekend trading hours. It is a convenient stop for prescriptions, over-the-counter medicine, or a beauty and personal-care top-up while running other errands.

Clicks Pharmacy Eden on the Bay is a branch of the Clicks health, beauty and pharmacy chain, combining a dispensary with the retailer's usual range of cosmetics, toiletries, homeware and everyday health products. As with other Clicks pharmacies, it offers ClubCard rewards and basic health advice alongside prescription dispensing, plus seasonal promotions on skincare and personal care lines.

The store trades from Eden on the Bay Mall in Big Bay, Bloubergstrand, serving residents and visitors in the area's growing coastal suburb. It is a convenient option for collecting prescriptions, picking up toiletries, or browsing the chain's beauty and homeware ranges while out at the mall on a weekend visit.

Clicks Pharmacy Edgemead is a branch of the Clicks health, beauty and pharmacy retail chain, combining a dispensary with cosmetics, toiletries and general health and household products. The chain operates dozens of stores across greater Cape Town, from Sea Point and Rondebosch to Franschhoek and Table View, with Edgemead forming part of that wider network of neighbourhood pharmacies.

This branch trades from Edgemead Shopping Centre on Louis Thibault Drive in Edgemead, serving the surrounding suburb with extended trading hours through the week and over weekends. It is a practical stop for prescriptions, everyday health needs and beauty essentials close to home without a long drive to a bigger centre.

Clicks Pharmacy Hout Bay is a branch of the Clicks health, beauty and pharmacy chain, categorised alongside medical clinics and vitamin and supplement stores for the range of health services it offers. The pharmacy combines prescription dispensing with the chain's usual retail range of cosmetics, toiletries and household health products, along with basic advice from pharmacy staff on common ailments.

The store trades from the corner of Princess and Main Road in Hout Bay, serving the valley's residents alongside other nearby pharmacies in the area. It is a convenient option for prescriptions, over-the-counter medicine and everyday beauty or health shopping without leaving Hout Bay for a bigger centre.

Clicks Pharmacy Welgemoed is a branch of the Clicks health, beauty and pharmacy chain, offering a dispensary alongside the retailer's ClubCard rewards programme, Health Hub and Beauty Hub ranges. Shoppers can fill prescriptions, get basic health advice and shop the chain's usual cosmetics and toiletries range in a single visit, without needing to travel to a larger pharmacy.

The pharmacy trades from Welgemoed Forum at the corner of Jip de Jager and Kommissaris Streets in Welgemoed, serving the surrounding northern suburbs community. It keeps extended hours through the week and over weekends, making it a convenient stop for prescriptions and everyday health and beauty needs close to home.

Clicks Sanbury Square is a branch of the Clicks health, beauty and pharmacy chain, combining a dispensary with the retailer's usual range of cosmetics, toiletries and household health products. It trades within Sanbury Square Shopping Centre on Old Faure Road in Eerste River, alongside other retailers including a bank, a hardware store and a supermarket.

Running regular healthcare and beauty promotions throughout the year, the store serves the Eerste River community with prescriptions and everyday pharmacy needs. It is a convenient stop for residents picking up medicine, health products or beauty essentials close to home while doing other shopping in the centre.

The Thornton Campus of the College of Cape Town is a public TVET college campus offering technical and vocational training in fields such as Building and Civil Engineering, Engineering and Related Design, and Mechanical Engineering. The campus also runs trade testing for trades including plumbing and welding, giving students a recognised qualification route into skilled trade work.

Situated on the corner of Poplar and Cedar Avenue in Thornton, the campus forms part of the wider College of Cape Town network of campuses across the city. It serves school leavers and working adults looking to gain a technical qualification or have existing trade skills formally assessed and certified.

Copper Club Eatery is a casual eatery in Newlands' Dean Street Arcade known for wood-fired pizzas and homemade burgers, with Swiss burgers and onion pizza among the dishes regularly mentioned by diners. The restaurant also pours craft beer and wine, and runs a half-price burger special on Wednesday evenings.

The venue has a relaxed, homely feel with a cosy interior, and it keeps long trading hours through the week and over weekends to suit breakfast, lunch and dinner crowds. It is a popular casual option for Newlands locals wanting burgers, pizza and a drink without booking a formal sit-down restaurant.

County Fair is a chicken brand under Astral Foods, producing fresh, frozen and value-added chicken products including wors, ready meals and recipe inspiration aimed at home cooks. The brand sits alongside other Astral-owned chicken brands and positions itself around simple, wholesome meals for everyday family cooking, with new recipes and seasonal ranges added through the year.

Operating from Bofors Circle in Epping Industria, the site forms part of Astral Foods' Western Cape poultry production and distribution network. It supplies retailers and food-service customers across the region, making it a significant local link in the chain between poultry farming and the dinner table in Cape Town homes.

Crazy Pets Brackenfell Corner is a branch of the Crazy Pets chain, a South African pet-supply retailer with more than 36 branches nationwide. The store stocks pet food, toys, bedding, aquarium and small-animal supplies, and accessories for dogs, cats and other household pets, with staff able to advise on feeding and basic pet care.

It trades from Brackenfell Corner Shopping Centre on Frans Conradie Avenue in Brackenfell, among a mix of grocery, fashion and food retailers in the same centre. The branch is a convenient option for pet owners in the area restocking food, picking up accessories, or sourcing supplies for a newly adopted pet.

Crema Design is a furniture and lighting showroom in Woodstock, bringing in international designer brands across lighting, rugs and indoor and outdoor furniture. Housed in a restored Victorian building dating to 1889, the showroom has built a reputation among Cape Town's design-conscious shoppers for its curated, imported collections spanning multiple design houses.

Reviewers describe the space as a boutique store with an informed, friendly team guiding customers through an international product range not often found elsewhere in the city. Based on Buitenkant Street, it suits interior designers, architects and homeowners looking for statement lighting or furniture pieces to anchor a considered interior scheme.

Crossroads 1 Clinic is a City of Cape Town primary healthcare facility serving the Crossroads community in the Nyanga health district. Services offered include child health, family planning, general HIV care, STI assessment and treatment, TB assessment and treatment, cancer screening, and pre-exposure prophylaxis for HIV prevention, covering much of a household's routine healthcare needs under one roof.

The clinic is on Old Klipfontein Road in Crossroads and operates on weekday mornings and afternoons as a public health facility. It serves as a local point of access to primary care, preventive screening and chronic treatment programmes for residents who might otherwise need to travel further for a public clinic.

Crown National Factory Mart is a factory shop selling spices, herbs, seasonings and sauces alongside meat-processing supplies such as packaging and casings used by the food industry. The factory shop format gives both home cooks and small food businesses access to Crown National's production-grade ingredients and supplies, usually at prices closer to wholesale than typical retail.

This branch trades from Brackenfell Corner Shopping Centre on the corner of Frans Conradie Drive and Paradys Street in Brackenfell, forming one of a network of Crown National branches around the country. It is a useful stop for butchers, caterers and home cooks wanting spices, seasonings or meat-processing materials in one visit.

CTM Northgate is a branch of the CTM tile and bathroom retail chain, stocking tiles, sanitaryware, taps and bathroom fittings for renovation and building projects. Reviewers note a wide tile selection and sales staff willing to open and compare multiple options across different ranges to help customers find the right match for a project.

The store trades from the Northgate Business Park on Platinum Drive in Brooklyn, in the same business park as several other tile, bathroom and plumbing suppliers. It is a practical stop for homeowners renovating a bathroom or kitchen, as well as builders and contractors sourcing tiles and sanitaryware for a project.

Curate is a fine-dining restaurant at Ellerman House, a Relais & Chateaux boutique hotel in Bantry Bay, occupying the property's wine gallery for an immersive, multi-course tasting experience. The menu explores South African flavours with wine pairings chosen to match each course, drawing on the same culinary team behind the hotel's other dining room.

Seating is limited to around 30 guests per sitting, giving the restaurant an intimate, considered feel in keeping with the rest of the hotel. It suits special-occasion dinners, wine-focused evenings, and guests wanting a refined, structured tasting menu rather than an a la carte meal in Bantry Bay.

Danneberg Optometrist has practised in Rondebosch since 1987, offering comprehensive eye examinations, contact lens fittings, retinal photography and glaucoma screening. The practice combines routine vision testing with screening for underlying eye conditions, giving patients a single appointment for both prescription and general eye-health checks rather than separate visits elsewhere, and stocks a range of frames to choose from once a prescription is confirmed.

The practice is based in Riverside Mall on Belmont Road in Rondebosch, with weekday and Saturday morning appointments available to suit patients working during the week. It serves patients needing new glasses or contact lenses, as well as those due for a routine eye-health check in the southern suburbs.

Dawood Butchery is a halaal butchery in Delft, part of a business that has supplied Cape Town communities with meat for more than 50 years. The butchery focuses on quality halaal meat products, offering a range of cuts and groceries alongside its core butchery counter, with regular specials on bulk cuts for freezer stock-ups.

Based on Delft Main Road in The Hague, Delft, the butchery trades among several other halaal meat markets and grocery stores in the surrounding area. It is a local option for households and small caterers wanting quality halaal meat, with a focus on customer satisfaction and value for money on everyday cuts.

De Kelder Restaurant & Winery is a family-friendly restaurant and wine venue built around local and international dishes paired with an extensive wine list drawn from South African wineries. The restaurant also caters for private celebrations and corporate functions, with event packages tailored to birthdays, anniversaries and similar gatherings in a cosy, welcoming setting.

The restaurant trades from Plattekloof Shopping Centre at the corner of Plattekloof and Olienhout Drive, keeping long hours that run from morning through to late evening most days. It suits a relaxed family meal, a wine-focused dinner, or a booked function for a group celebrating a special occasion.

Debonairs Pizza is a long-running South African pizza chain known for its Triple-Decker and other speciality pizzas, alongside pasta, chicken wings, submarine sandwiches and desserts. Branches typically operate on a mix of dine-in, takeaway, delivery and online ordering, giving customers several ways to get a meal.

This outlet trades from Avonwood Square at the corner of 35th Avenue and Balvenie Road in Elsies River, serving the surrounding community with the chain's usual pizza and fast-food menu. It is a convenient option for a quick family dinner, a takeaway on the way home, or a delivery order for a night in.

Debonairs Pizza Grassy Park is a branch of the national pizza chain, serving its iconic Triple-Decker pizzas alongside the more affordable Real Deal range, made with quality ingredients and a distinctly South African flavour. The store offers dine-in, takeaway and online ordering for delivery, giving customers a choice of how they want their meal.

The outlet trades from Victoria Mall on 4th Avenue in Grassy Park, keeping long hours into the evening every day of the week. It is a popular option for a quick family meal, a shared pizza night, or a delivery order for anyone in the Grassy Park area.

Delft Community Health Centre is a Western Cape Government primary healthcare facility offering extended-hour care for the surrounding community. Services include X-ray facilities, emergency stabilisation, round-the-clock maternity care, chronic medication dispensing, child health services and family planning, making it a larger facility than a typical neighbourhood clinic.

Based at the corner of Delft Main Road and Voorbrug Road in Delft, the centre operates as a public facility serving a large catchment area in the northern reaches of Cape Town's Cape Flats. It gives local residents access to a wider range of services than a standard clinic, including maternity care, without needing a referral to a hospital.

Diep River Roadworthy Centre CC is a vehicle testing and certification centre in Diep River, inspecting cars against the legal safety standards required to keep a vehicle licensed on South African roads. The centre operates as a testing facility aligned with the Department of Motor Vehicles, assessing items such as brakes, lights, tyres and general roadworthiness.

Based on Main Road in Diep River, the centre trades alongside several nearby fuel stations and a carwash in the same stretch of road. It serves motorists across the southern suburbs who need a routine roadworthy certificate, whether for a vehicle licence renewal or ahead of selling a car.

Dimples Dumpling House specialises in the Cantonese art of dim sum, meaning roughly touch the heart, serving small, bite-sized steamed and fried dishes such as handmade dumplings filled with prawns and chives or pork and cabbage. The dim sum house has also extended its menu into Japanese-style ramen, broadening its appeal beyond a single cuisine.

This branch trades on Main Road in Kenilworth, and advance phone orders are recommended in the evenings when the dumpling counter gets busy. It suits diners wanting a sit-down dim sum meal, a shared plate of small dishes, or a bowl of ramen in the southern suburbs.

Dis-Chem Sitari Fields is a branch of the Dis-Chem pharmacy chain, which has operated in South Africa since 1978 as one of the country's leading pharmacy, beauty and wellness retailers. The branch combines a dispensary and in-store clinic with the chain's usual range of health, beauty and sports-supplement products, plus seasonal promotions across its beauty and wellness ranges.

Click & collect is available alongside standard in-store shopping, and the clinic keeps slightly shorter hours than the main pharmacy floor. Trading from Sitari Village Centre on Old Main Road in Croydon, the branch serves the Sitari Fields area with pharmacy and wellness services close to home.

Distell is one of Africa's leading producers and marketers of wines, spirits, ciders and other ready-to-drink beverages, with a significant bottling and merchandising presence in Cape Town. The Epping Industria site includes a large bottling operation known as Green Park, alongside a separate warehouse used for merchandising activities.

Based on Bofors Circle in Epping Industria, one of Cape Town's most central industrial areas, the site sits close to major road links including the N1, N2, N7 and M5. It forms part of the beverage production and distribution network that supplies Distell's wine, spirits and cider brands to retailers across the region.

Doncaster Motors is a fuel station operating under the Caltex brand, with a FreshStop convenience store on site alongside the fuel pumps. FreshStop outlets are designed to give motorists a quick stop for snacks, drinks and everyday convenience items while filling up with petrol or diesel, with attendants on hand to help at the pumps.

The station is at the corner of Doncaster Road and Punters Way in Kenilworth, serving commuters and residents passing through the suburb. It is a straightforward stop for fuel, a quick snack, or basic forecourt services without needing to detour far from the main road through Kenilworth.
